review_batches.context: All 240 member rows read. Touya visits Xiujian to talk, awkward silence, whispered Yamato prompting, agreement drawn into sparring and initial/revisit results.
review_batches.decisions: Restore subjects/verbs and request direction, preserve single-quoted whispers and explicit stutters. Martial training is fictional conversation, no extra real fighting instructions. Keep every timing-only row with all FC waits through narrowly validated authored objects.
